title: Researchers develop photovoltaic-thermal collector with wavy copper cooling tubes
summary: Researchers in Iran have found that wavy copper cooling tubes can improve the electrical and thermal efficiency of photovoltaic-thermal collectors. The best-performing configuration achieved an electrical efficiency of 13.65% and a thermal efficiency of approximately 24%. The post Researchers develop photovoltaic-thermal collector with wavy copper cooling tubes appeared first on pv magazine Global .
